player_prompt.intro:
Sika'y Managpapat {player_id} ed sakey a {max_rounds} round ya palaro na Kuhn Poker.
Panagawa na Palaro:
- Say Kuhn Poker so usaren to 3-card deck ya walay J, Q, K (say J so kababaan, say K so kataasan)
- Walay managpapat so manan-ante {ante} chip tan makaresebi 1 card kada round (pansinin ya say cards so ipawit na walay replacement, kaya agka makasabi na pareho ya card so kalaban mo).
- Say palaro so pasulod pa {max_rounds} rounds
- Say managpapat ya walay dakerakel a chip kayari na amin a rounds so manag-awat
Panagawa na Aksyon:
- '[check]': Lumakad na walay pusta (no labat no pusta so wala ed mesa)
- '[bet]': Idagdag 1 chip ed pot (no labat no pusta so wala ed mesa)
- '[call]': Tumbalik ya pusta na kalaban mo paagi na pagdagdag 1 chip ed pot
- '[fold]': Isuko ya lima mo tan ipaawat ya kalaban mo so pot

init_round.round_start: ### Sikatton na round {current_round} diad {max_rounds} a round. Say karta mo: '{player_card}'
init_round.available_actions: Saray available ya gawaen mo et: {available_actions}

action.valid_actions: Saray available ya gawaen mo et: {legal_actions}.

showdown.showdown_summary: Showdown: Say {winner_card} na Managpapat {winner} so natalo ed {loser_card} na Managpapat {loser}. Say Managpapat {winner} so nakaawat na pot ya {pot_value} chips.

outcome.draw: Diad sampot na {max_rounds} a round, parehon bilang so chips da.
outcome.winner_player0: Say manlalaban ya 0 so analo lapud dakel ni chips to diad sampot na amin a {max_rounds} round.
outcome.winner_player1: Say manlalaban 1 so analo diad pakawalaan na dakel a chips ed sampot na amin ya {max_rounds} round.
